content: {"reasoning":"CO-97 means the service is bundled into another paid service, which is a coding/bundling dispute, not medical necessity. The prior appeal_with_necessity was the wrong tool and got nowhere. A bundling denial is best challenged by demonstrating the service was distinct and separately payable, which requires supporting documentation/modifier correction. Correcting the claim (e.g., adding an appropriate modifier to indicate a distinct service) and resubmitting directly addresses the CO-97 root cause.","action":"correct_and_resubmit"}
